programme.title: IP MAN 1 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: SECRET: UNTOLD MELODY [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: THE RETURN OF ASIA’S MOST BELOVED FANTASY ROMANCE - A PROMISING PIANIST IN A SLUMP HAS A CHANCE MEETING WITH A YOUNG WOMAN PLAYING MYSTERIOUS MUSIC, AND THE ENCOUNTER FORCES HIM TO MAKE A ONCE-IN-A-LIFETIME CHOICE

programme.title: Sinkhole [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: After finally realizing his dream of owning a house in Seoul, Dong-won held housewarming parties and invited some of his co-workers. But his happiness is short-lived as the entire building falls to the ground. Dongwon, his co-workers Kim and Eun-joo, and a nosy neighbor, Man-soo, must make it out of a 500-meter sinkhall.

programme.title: Hard Hit [English Dub]
programme.desc: On his way to work, a bank manager receives an anonymous call claiming there's a bomb under his car seat, and if anyone exits the car, it will explode unless he can pay a ransom.

programme.title: My Way [English Dub]
programme.desc: Rivals Jun Shik and Tatsuo face captivity, separation, and reconciliation amidst colonization and war.

programme.title: Citizen of a Kind [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Deok-hee needs a loan as her house and laundry have burned down. One day, she receives a call from someone claiming to be a bank manager offering her a loan. She agrees to various fees the manager asks for, but it is a voicemail scam. Deok-hee is now homeless with no help to take care of her children. Then, The so-called 'manager' contacts her again, this time pleading for his life. However, when Deok-hee seeks help from the police, they refuse to investigate, citing a lack of evidence. With no other options, Deok-hee decides to take matters into her own hands and get her money back.

programme.title: The Frontline [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A drama centered on the Korean War's final battle that will determine the border between north and south.

programme.title: The Night Owl [English Dub]
programme.desc: A period drama film, depicting Joseon Dynasty in Korea. Kyoung-su is a skilled acupuncturist but a blind who can only see a little at dark. Right after Kyoung-su joins King Injo’s medical team, the prince comes back after 7 years of living in Chung dynasty. Due to a long journey coming back, the prince becomes ill, and the king’s doctor brings Kyoung-su to heal him. But while Kyoung-su is doing his work, he finds out the king’s hidden secret which might change everything that the king owns. Could Kyoung-su be able to save everyone and himself?

programme.title: THE ASSASSINS [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the year 198, Cao Cao, Prime Minister of the Han Dynasty, ventured to the east and defeated China's greatest warrior Lu Bu, terrifying every ambitious warlord across the country. Several years later, after taking the Han Emperor under his wing, Cao crowns himself King of Wei. He built a magnificent Bronze Sparrow Island to symbolize his power and rumors spread that he would replace the Emperor. Meanwhile, young lovers Mu Shun and Ling Ju are taken from a prison camp to a hidden tomb, where they spend five cruel years together, training as assassins for a secret mission. In the year 220 astronomical signs predict dramatic change. As a result, Cao's son Cao Pi and Cao's followers urge Cao to become the new Emperor - but unknown opposing forces plot against him.

programme.title: THE GREAT WAR OF ARCHIMEDES [English Dub]
programme.desc: It is the early 1930s and the command of the Japanese Imperial Navy determines to construct the world's biggest and most formidable battleship, Yamato. One of the admirals, Yamamoto Isoroku, disagrees. He recruits the upstart and mathematics' expert Tadashi Kai who discovers there are discrepancies between the official cost estimates and the actual figures. They soon find out that they have stumbled upon a conspiracy.

programme.title: Bad City [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Kaiko City is plagued with poverty and crime. When a corrupt businessman decides to run for mayor and starts eliminating opponents from the rival mafia, a former police captain serving time for murder is secretly released and put in charge of a special task force to arrest him.
